Winkraft Ladders & Scaffolding is a trusted name in aluminium ladders and scaffolding solutions, serving customers with a focus on quality, safety, durability and dependable performance.

Based at 2 locations, RP Road Secunderabad and Ayyappa Society, Madhapur Telangana, Winkraft provides practical access solutions designed to meet the requirements of construction, industrial, commercial, residential and maintenance applications.

Our product range is developed with a strong emphasis on strength, stability, ease of handling and user safety. We aim to provide reliable products that help professionals and businesses carry out work at height with greater convenience.

At Winkraft, we believe that quality is more than just a product feature. It is a commitment to our customers. From product selection to customer service, we strive to maintain consistent standards and build long-term relationships with our clients.

  • Wide span (double width) towers, 1.35 m wide, give space for tools, material and personnel. A safe, comfortable mobile tower for frequent access with heavy and bulky loads.
  • Winkraft scaffolding and ladder system towers are fully industrial duty and robustly manufactured from 50 mm dia aluminium alloy tube as per international quality standards.
  • Platforms at every 2 metres make access easier.
  • Stairways with 100 mm deep, non-slip tread surfaces and an entry platform.
  • Extruded steps designed to be safe and comfortable to traverse forwards and backwards.
  • Stairway rails and ladder hand rails add to the all-round safety and comfort of ascent and descent.
  • 200 mm dia height-adjustable castors with dual locking facility cope with uneven surfaces for ease of mobility and handling.
  • All ‘H’ frames are interchangeable except the entry frame, without modification or additional components. Special guard rail frames are provided as per customer requirement.
  • All towers are tested as per international standards. Maximum safe working load is 200 kg/m².

Wide span (double width) aluminium scaffolding, without stairway

Width
1.35 m
Platforms
Every 2 m, or at approx. 300 mm intervals if required
Castors
200 mm dia, adjustable, dual locking
Platform
Phenolic coated plywood, with trap door
M.S. base frame

Max safe working load

  • Wide span (double width) towers, 1.35 m wide, give space for tools, material and personnel. The main frame is designed for people who need to use it as a ladder for ascent and descent.
  • Platforms at every 2 metres make access easier. If required, platform levels can be used in height at approximately 300 mm intervals, ensuring a comfortable working height wherever the job is required.
  • All ‘H’ frames are interchangeable except the entry frame, without modification or additional components. Special guard rail frames are provided as per customer requirement.
  • 200 mm dia height-adjustable castors with dual locking facility cope with uneven surfaces for ease of mobility and handling.
  • Anti-skid, waterproof, fire-retardant and phenolic coated highly compressed plywood platforms are provided with trap door and locking facility. Aluminium checkered sheet platform can be provided on customer request at additional cost.
  • M.S. base frame with 200 mm castor wheels and heavy duty screw jacks for height and level adjustment is provided for scaffolds with platform height 11 metres and above.
  • All towers are tested as per international standards. Maximum safe working load is 200 kg/m².

1000×1800 mm medium width aluminium scaffolding

Size
1000 × 1800 mm
Stability
Adjustable outriggers
Platforms
Wooden or aluminium checkered sheet
  • If space is limited and a budget-friendly scaffolding is required, Winkraft has an excellent solution: 1000×1800 mm medium width aluminium scaffolding. At 1000 mm wide they fit in many areas where a wide span (double width) tower will not.
  • The adjustable outriggers allow for multiple adaptations. When fully extracted, they provide secure support on any surface for safe working conditions at extended heights. When retracted, the tower can easily be moved through alleys, doorways and similar spaces, or used for wall side applications.
  • Easy to handle thanks to light weight, push-in connections on frame sections and snap fasteners on braces.
  • Winkraft’s WK Towers are the lowest cost and most popular design of industrial aluminium alloy towers.
  • Winkraft towers are available with wooden or aluminium checkered sheet platforms as per customer requirement.

Mini aluminium scaffolding

Smaller jobs that need height access from a scaffold? Here’s a mini scaffolding system you can fit almost anywhere, for excellent access to exterior and interior heights.

Standard castors
150 mm dia
Adjustable castors (recommended)
200 mm dia
Toe guard (optional)
Aluminium or wooden
Stairway ladder
Optional
  • Fits through any standard-width interior and exterior door. Great for painters, roofers, building maintenance personnel and almost any application.
  • Minimal bracing required. Erects and packs down in minutes by one person.
  • Easy to move around: ultra strong yet lightweight aluminium alloy construction.
  • Stairway ladder is optional.
  • Optional toe guard, in aluminium or wooden.
  • Mini scaffold without ladder: personnel must always climb to the work platform from the inside of the tower.
  • Choose between standard castors (150 mm dia) or adjustable castors (200 mm dia). We recommend adjustable castors for outdoor use, so you can adjust for uneven terrain and keep the tower level.
